question.text: At the quarterly investment committee meeting of Tejas Growth Equity Fund, partner Mr. Vikram Rao is reviewing the deal funnel. 'Deal sourcing' as a key role of the AIF Investment Manager MOST accurately refers to:

answer.text: Identifying favourable investment opportunities, prospecting for transactions, and relationship-management with investment bankers, chartered accountants, corporate advisers, consulting firms, senior corporate heads/executives and policy makers to build an ecosystem for deal generation and execution.
The RTA generating a monthly subscription report.
The custodian settling purchase trades within T+1.
The merchant banker filing the PPM with SEBI.

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes deal sourcing as a core manager role — identifying favourable opportunities, sourcing and completing successful transactions, prospecting, and relationship management with investment bankers, chartered accountants, corporate advisers, consulting firms, senior corporate heads/executives and policy makers. This network is what builds the ecosystem for deal generation and execution. The Trap: Option B is an RTA operational function. Option C is custodian settlement. Option D is the merchant banker's scheme-launch filing role — all adjacent service-provider activities, distinct from manager deal-sourcing. Note: Anchor 'deal sourcing' to the workbook's two ideas — opportunity identification and active relationship-management with the named professional ecosystem.
